objective_convention: Q = gross_operational_cost = sum TSO/DSO get_primal_value (objective_function_rule, weighted Y_y D_d (1+r)^-(y-y0)) - contracted interface settlement - interface-voltage pin; net = Q - terminal salvage credit; F = I + Q. At one market scenario the deviation settlement is identically 0, so "settlement excluded" is exact there; at 3 x 3 the deviation settlement and the row 18 premium are INSIDE Q.
formula_I: I(x) = sum_n (1+r)^-(y-y0) * sum_c w_c * (cS_{c,y} S_n + cE_{c,y} E_n); verdict ADMISSIBLE iff I(x) <= B + 1e-08; BOUNDARY iff admissible and B - I(x) < 0.01 B

gen_cost_line.text: gen_cost_scenario += c_p[p] * network.baseMVA * model.pg[g, s_m, s_o, p]

gen_cost_filter.text: if network.generators[g].is_controllable() and not (not network.is_transmission and network.generators[g].gen_type == GEN_REFERENCE):

gen_curt_line.text: gen_curt_penalty += penalty * network.baseMVA * (model.pg_avail[g, s_o, p] - model.pg[g, s_m, s_o, p])

sess_usage_line.text: cost += model.penalty_shared_ess_usage * network.baseMVA * (model.shared_es_pch[e, s_m0, s_o0, p] + model.shared_es_pdch[e, s_m0, s_o0, p])

v_slack_line.text: total += PENALTY_VOLTAGE_SQUARED * (model.slack_v_sqr_down[i, s_m, s_o, p] + model.slack_v_sqr_up[i, s_m, s_o, p])

nb_slack_line.text: total += base * PENALTY_NODE_BALANCE * (model.slack_node_balance_p_up[i, s_m, s_o, p] + model.slack_node_balance_p_down[i, s_m, s_o, p])

bf_slack_line.text: total += base * PENALTY_CURRENT * (model.slack_flow_ij_sqr[b, s_m, s_o, p])

flexdb_slack_line.text: total += base * PENALTY_FLEXIBILITY * (model.slack_flex_p_balance_up[c, s_m, s_o] + model.slack_flex_p_balance_down[c, s_m, s_o])

local_closure_line.text: total += base * PENALTY_ESS_BALANCE * (model.slack_es_soc_final_up[e, s_m, s_o] + model.slack_es_soc_final_down[e, s_m, s_o])

shared_closure_line.text: total += base * PENALTY_SHARED_ESS_BALANCE * (model.slack_shared_es_soc_final_up[e, s_m0, s_o0] + model.slack_shared_es_soc_final_down[e, s_m0, s_o0])

esso_slack_pen.text: slack_penalty += PENALTY_ESSO_SLACK * (model.slack_es_pnet_up[y_inv, d, p] + model.slack_es_pnet_down[y_inv, d, p])

master_annualization.text: investment_cost_total += annualization * omega_m * model.es_s_investment[e, y] * c_inv_s

C1_Q_includes.text: It includes TN generation costs, activated DN flexibility, load curtailment, and penalties on storage energy-closure and network-feasibility slacks. In the multi-scenario instance, it also includes the commitment charge and the deviation component of interface settlement

C1_contracted_excluded.text: The contracted component of interface settlement is excluded as a transfer between operators. Storage-agent and solver regularisation terms are also excluded. Renewable curtailment is assigned no cost and is reported separately as curtailed energy.

C1_weights.text: The weights $Y_y$ and $D_d$ are the numbers of calendar years and days represented by $y$ and $d$, respectively. Operating costs are discounted to $y_0$ using the representative year $y$.

C1_premium_additional.text: The deviation premium is additional to settlement at the corresponding scenario prices.

C1_no_tso_premium.text: No deviation premium is imposed on the TSO.

C1_single_scenario_omitted.text: With a single scenario, the interface exchange equals its expected value and the deviation-charge term is omitted.

C1_appA_settlement.text: The interface settlement is carried at full weight: its contracted part is removed from the reported cost as a transfer, its deviation part is kept. A quadratic regularisation of the interface-voltage dispersion across scenarios is added to the TSO and DSO models as a solver-side term and removed from the reported cost.

C1_appA_single.text: At a single scenario the commitment charge and the voltage regularisation are not constructed; the interface settlement remains in every local objective at full weight and is excluded from the reported cost as a transfer.

C1_appE_blanket.text: Throughout, $Q$ is the gross operational cost, settlement excluded; the net form subtracts the terminal salvage credit~\eqref{eq:salvage_credit}

C1_benchmark_same_Q.text: All arrangements are evaluated using the same cost function $Q$, excluding interface settlement.

C1_block_weight.text: Each network block objective is divided by a common scale $\sigma$ and multiplied by its block weight $w_{y,d} = Y_y D_d (1+r)^{-(y-y_0)}$

C1_no_cycling_cost.text: No explicit monetary cycling cost is included

C1_salvage_after.text: The credit is calculated after the operational evaluation and does not affect dispatch or investment selection.

C1_salvage_limitations.text: Terminal salvage credits are excluded from the planning objective and reported only in net values.

C1_salvage_reported.text: The credit is reported, not optimized: the recourse does not see it, no plan is selected for it

C1_passive_rescurt.text: In the passive arrangement, the DN dispatch objective includes a renewable-curtailment coefficient of 1~\euro/MWh. This auxiliary term is excluded from the reported operating cost $Q$.
